facts.fact: Senegal's National Assembly adopted in plenary on 20 August 2026 the bill that institutes a national cybersecurity authority with legal personality, backed by a national CERT; promulgation is not stated.
facts.system: Autorité nationale de Cybersécurité du Sénégal

facts.fact: The adopted law classes systems of national defence, public security, the courts, the prison administration and customs as critical information infrastructure by operation of law, and requires operators to report serious incidents to the Authority within 24 hours.
facts.system: Autorité nationale de Cybersécurité du Sénégal
